title: Renderer: CSS pixel-ratio aware canvas (HiDPI fix)
description: The renderer canvas does not account for devicePixelRatio, causing blurry rendering on Retina/HiDPI displays. Fix in packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx and renderer.ts: set canvas.width = stageW * dpr, canvas.height = stageH * dpr, ctx.scale(dpr, dpr), then set CSS width/height to stageW/stageH px. This is separate from the toolbox DPI issue (0116). The same fix applies to the off-screen onion skin canvas. Add a note in renderer.ts about the dpr scaling. No new tests needed (visual-only fix). Only touches StageArea.tsx and renderer.ts — NOT Shell.tsx.
